# Содежимое файла userDependControl.ts {#sec-api-userDependControl .appendix}

``` python
import {Response, Request} from 'express'
import { createDb, getQuery, runQuery } from '../../db/queryDb'
import { NotificationType, UserRoleType } from '../../types/user'

type UserDeleteDependsReqType = {
    nodeId: number,
    adminId: number
}

type UserGetDependsReqType = {
    clientId: number,
    role: UserRoleType
}

type UserConfirmDependReqType = {
    nodeId: number,
    adminId: number,
    notificationId: number
}

type UserDenyDependReqType = {
    notificationId: number
}

export const userDeleteDepends = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const {nodeId, adminId}: UserDeleteDependsReqType = req.body;
    
    const db = createDb(res)

    try {
        await runQuery(
            db,
            'DELETE FROM node_depends WHERE node_id = ? AND admin_id = ?',
            [nodeId, adminId]
        )

        db.close()

        res.json({
            success: true,
            info: []
        })
    } catch (e) {
        db.close()
        
        res.json({
            success: false,
            text: 'Произошла непредвиденная ошибка'
        })
    }
}

export const userGetDepends = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const {clientId, role}: UserGetDependsReqType = req.body;

    const db = createDb(res)

    try {
        const dependIds = await getQuery<{
            id: number,
            username: string
        }>(
            db,
            `
            SELECT t1.id, t1.username
            FROM vpn_users AS t1
            INNER JOIN node_depends AS t2
            ON t1.id = t2.${role === 'node' ? 'admin_id' : 'node_id'}
            WHERE ${role === 'node' ? 'node_id' : 'admin_id'} = ?;
            `,
            [clientId]
        )

        db.close()

        res.json({
            success: true,
            info: dependIds
        })
    } catch (e) {
        db.close()

        res.json({
            success: false,
            text: 'Произошла непредвиденная ошибка'
        })
    }
}

export const userConfirmDepend = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const {nodeId, adminId, notificationId}: UserConfirmDependReqType = req.body;

    const db = createDb(res)

    try {
        const notification = await getQuery<{
            id: number,
            client_id: number,
            type: NotificationType,
            payload: string,
            is_read: boolean
        }>(
            db,
            'SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE id = ?',
            [notificationId]
        )

        if (notification.length > 0) {
            await runQuery(
                db,
                'DELETE FROM notifications WHERE id = ?',
                [notificationId]
            )

            const depend = await getQuery<{
                id: number,
                node_id: number,
                admin_id: number
            }>(
                db,
                'SELECT * FROM node_depends WHERE node_id = ? AND admin_id = ?',
                [nodeId, adminId]
            )

            if (depend.length === 0) {
                await runQuery(
                    db,
                    'INSERT INTO node_depends (node_id, admin_id) VALUES (?, ?)',
                    [nodeId, adminId]
                )
            }
        }

        db.close()

        res.json({
            success: true,
            info: []
        })

    } catch (e) {
        db.close()

        res.json({
            success: false,
            text: 'Произошла непредвиденная ошибка'
        })
    }
}

export const userDenyDepend = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const {notificationId}: UserDenyDependReqType = req.body;

    const db = createDb(res)

    try {
        const notificationArr = await getQuery<{
            id: number,
            client_id: number,
            type: NotificationType,
            payload: string,
            is_read: boolean
        }>(
            db,
            'SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE id = ?',
            [notificationId]
        )

        if (notificationArr.length > 0) {
            await runQuery(
                db,
                'DELETE FROM notifications WHERE id = ?',
                [notificationId]
            )
        }

        db.close()

        res.json({
            success: true,
            info: []
        })

    } catch (e) {
        db.close()

        res.json({
            success: false,
            text: 'Произошла непредвиденная ошибка'
        })
    }
}
```
